provenance.scope: Complete native common-base routines with synthetic gameplay context, native-shaped empty two-sentinel lists, and preallocated poisoned object storage. Does not execute gameplay/list allocation, deleting free, dispatch, derived classes or common completion callbacks.

normalization.list_entries: [object_id, object-relative node offset in bytes], ordered from head.next to tail; offsets4/16/28 are distinct memberships
normalization.objects: Only live objects; constructor position bytes intentionally retain fill_byte until a non-null context overwrites them. Unknown word3A and surrounding guards are checked unchanged but omitted.
normalization.seed_fields: Explicit synthetic initial state writes, not native calls.
normalization.swap_owners: Raw pointer exchange only: flag0 swaps gameplay+10/+14; flag1 swaps gameplay+08/+0C. No object bytes change and no manager pass executes. This step has no object field.
normalization.owners: Current logical owner maps to a physical primary/secondary list; list arrays retain physical membership independent of pointer swaps.
normalization.native_steps: All steps except seed_fields and swap_owners execute the named unmodified native routine.
